title: CrossEntryopy fails silently

labels.name: module: crash
labels.description: Problem manifests as a hard crash, as opposed to a RuntimeError

labels.name: module: loss
labels.description: Problem is related to loss function

labels.name: module: cuda
labels.description: Related to torch.cuda, and CUDA support in general

labels.name: triaged
labels.description: This issue has been looked at a team member, and triaged and prioritized into an appropriate module

body:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

when given invalid input, crossentropy fails silently.

```python
    import torch.nn.functional as F
    device = torch.device("cuda")

    ignore_index = 255
    b = 10
    classes = 3
    w = 768
    h = 1024
    predi = torch.zeros(b, classes, w, h, dtype=torch.float16).to(device)
    labels = torch.zeros(b, w, h, dtype=torch.int64).to(device)
    labels[5, 200, 200] = 255
    labels[5, 200, 200]= 254 # invalid class

    per_pixel_losses = F.cross_entropy(
        predi, labels, reduction="none", ignore_index=ignore_index
    )
    print(per_pixel_losses)
```
